title: dbt Model Build Failures
dataSources: Airflow logs (`airflow:scheduler`, `airflow:task`), Airflow StatsD/OTel metrics, dbt `run_results.json`/`sources.json` (`dbt:run_results`), dbt Cloud API run history, Dagster/Prefect run events.
app: Apache Airflow scheduler/worker logs and StatsD/OTel metrics via HEC; dbt run-results/manifest artifacts and dbt Cloud API via HEC scripted inputs; Dagster/Prefect event logs.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=dbt:run_results resource_type=model
| stats count as builds, sum(eval(status="error")) as failures by model
| eval failure_rate=round(100*failures/builds,1)
| where failures>0
| sort - failure_rate
description: Tracks dbt model build outcomes and ranks models by failure rate, exposing broken transformations that starve downstream tables.
value: A failed dbt model breaks every table and dashboard built on it; ranking by failure rate targets the transformations to fix first.
implementation: Emit run results to HEC; schedule after each run; alert on model build failures. Map models to consuming dashboards.
visualization: Table by failure rate, timechart of model failures.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the steps that reshape your raw data into report-ready tables and flag the ones that fail.
